items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: The second album I did was with Herb Ellis.

ctx.x: Al McKibbon — but he’s out here now.
Yeah. The second album I did was with Herb Ellis. And after that I draw a blank. I can’t remember one thing from another.
Do you think you play as well on record as you do in live situations?
